name: ECON 1202
title: Principles of Macroeconomics
description: The organization and function of the economic system as a total unit. Economic decisions, institutions, and policies that determine levels and rates of growth of production, employment, and prices. Topical subjects (e.g., government budget deficits and current interest-rate policy). CA 2.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed ECON 1200. May not be taken concurrently with ECON 1200. May be taken before or after ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150). May not be taken out of sequence after passing ECON 2198, 2202, 2212Q, or 2327.
